mBuff.mDescription:
Be More AfraidThis unit has been slowed by Shyvana.

"Oh noooo, she's coming to get meeeeeee!” — You, a coward

Buff the Magic DragonShyvana has transformed into a dragon, enhancing her abilities.

"You should see me when I'm angry.” – Shyvana

Strike TwoShyvana's next attack will strike in a circle around the target.

"IS” — Shyvana

Strike Three, You're OutShyvana's next attack will bite the target.

“DEMACIA!” — Shyvana

Be AfraidThis unit has been slowed by Shyvana.

"Oh noooo, she's coming to get meeeeeee!” — You, a coward

Strike OneShyvana's next attack will strike in a cone behind the target.

“THIS” — Shyvana

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing @Damage@ + @Calc_Max_Health_Damage@ Max health magic damage and Slowing by @Calc_Slow@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals @Calc_Dragon_Damage@ + @Calc_Max_Health_Dragon_Damage@ Max Health magic damage and Slows by @Calc_Slow_Dragon@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for @GroundLingerDuration@ seconds that deals @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second.

mBuff.mDescription:
ScalemailShyvana's natural defenses are enhanced.

"Yeah, I'm built different." — Shyvana

mLocKeys.keySummary: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Takedowns on champions, large minions, and monsters earn Shyvana stacks of {{Spell_Shyvana_Passive_Name}} %i:Shyvana%, each stack grants Shyvana permanent @BonusArmor@ Armor and @BonusMagicResist@ Magic Resist.

Bonus Armor: @Calc_Bonus_Armor@
Bonus Magic Resist: @Calc_Bonus_MR@
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_Shyvana_Passive_Tooltip}}

Large monsters and siege minions grant @Stacks_Per_Large_Monster@ stack.
Champions and Epic monsters grant @Stacks_Per_Epic_Monster@ stacks.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal @Calc_Max_Health_Damage@ max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Cooldown_Reduction@ seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing @Calc_Damage@ physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next @RecastDuration@ seconds.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing @Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage@ true damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal @Calc_Max_Health_Damage@ max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's cooldown by @Cooldown_Reduction@ seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes in a cone around the target, dealing @Calc_Damage@ physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or a short delay within @RecastDuration@ seconds; the Recast strikes in a circle around the target.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing @Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage@ true damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals @Calc_Monster_Bonus@ additional damage to monsters.
Maximum health damage does not affect structures and against non-champions has a minimum of @Calc_Max_Health_Monster_Minimum@ and maximum of @Calc_Max_Health_Monster_Maximum@.
Dragon Form's final Recast cannot critically strike.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates @Fury_Generation@ Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by @TT_Fury_Mult@ while in Dragon Form, and reduced @TT_Fury_AoE_Penalty@ by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing @Damage@ magic damage and causing them Flee for @FearDuration@ seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains @Calc_Bonus_Health@ bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Shyvana gains @FuryGainPerUltHaste*100@% increased Fury from all sources per 1 Ultimate Ability Haste. Ultimate Haste acquired while dead does not take effect until Shyvana revives.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription:
Going to Pump You UpShyvana is shielded and has increased movement speed.

"These losers, they need discipline!” — Shyvana remarking on the Demacian military trainees

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shyvana wraps herself in flames for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @Calc_Shield@ Shield, increased by @Calc_Shield_Per_Nearby_Champion@ per nearby enemy champion and @MoveSpeed@ Move Speed, increased to @MoveSpeedTowardsEnemies@ when moving towards enemy champions.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing @Damage@ magic damage.

Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for @Calc_Base_Heal@ + @Calc_Missing_Health_Heal@ Missing Health.
